labs.title: Manage users, groups, and directory roles in Microsoft Entra
labs.summary: Create a workforce user, organize access with a security group, scope the user to an administrative unit, and assign a least-privileged Microsoft Entra role in a simulated Entra admin center.
labs.scenario: Contoso is onboarding **Mira Ileri**, a finance analyst, while limiting helpdesk administration to the finance population. In the **simulated Microsoft Entra admin center** on your lab VM, create **mira.ileri@contoso.example** with the right profile attributes, create a **Finance App Access** security group, add Mira to the **Finance administrative unit**, and delegate **Password Administrator** to the **Contoso Helpdesk** group only at that administrative-unit scope. Done means Mira has access grouping, helpdesk can reset finance user passwords, and no broad tenant role was granted.
learningObjectives: Create an internal Microsoft Entra user with business attributes used for access decisions
Compare assigned and dynamic group membership for application access
Use administrative units to scope delegated administration
Assign the least-privileged Microsoft Entra role at the narrowest practical scope
prerequisites: Know that Microsoft Entra ID stores users, groups, and role assignments for a tenant

steps.title: Create the new finance user
steps.instruction: Go to **All users**, select **+ New user**, choose **Create new user**, and create **Mira Ileri** with user principal name **mira.ileri@contoso.example**. Keep **Auto-generate password (hidden in simulation)** and **Account enabled** selected. On **Properties**, set **Job title** to `Finance analyst`, **Department** to `Finance`, and **Usage location** to **Türkiye**.
steps.hint: Use the **Basics** and **Properties** tabs in the **New user** wizard. Do not enter or record a password.
steps.explanation: A user object is the identity record. Profile attributes such as department and usage location help later access and governance decisions.

rules.description: Mira Ileri exists as an enabled internal member
rules.failureFeedback: Create Mira as an enabled member in the contoso.example domain with Finance properties.

steps.title: Create the finance access group
steps.instruction: Go to **All groups**, select **New group**, and create a **Security** group named **Finance App Access** with **Assigned** membership. Add **Mira Ileri** as a member and **Alex Wilber** as an owner.
steps.hint: Assigned membership is intentional here because the application owner requested explicit membership. A dynamic group would use a rule such as `user.department -eq "Finance"`.
steps.explanation: Security groups collect identities that need the same authorization. Owners provide accountability for membership changes.

rules.description: Finance App Access is an assigned security group with Mira as a member
rules.failureFeedback: Create Finance App Access as a Security group with Assigned membership, Mira as member, and Alex as owner.

steps.title: Add Mira to the Finance administrative unit
steps.instruction: Open **Administrative units**, select **Finance administrative unit**, and use **Update members** to keep **Adele Vance** and add **Mira Ileri**.
steps.hint: Administrative units scope management. Do not use the Sales or External partners administrative unit.
steps.explanation: Administrative units reduce blast radius by limiting where a delegated role can act, such as only Finance users instead of the whole tenant.

rules.description: Mira is in the Finance administrative unit
rules.failureFeedback: Add mira.ileri@contoso.example to the Finance administrative unit and keep the existing Finance member.

steps.title: Open the Password Administrator role
steps.instruction: Go to **Roles & admins** and open the **Password Administrator** role.
steps.hint: The role table includes tempting broader roles. Choose the role that matches password reset support for non-admin users.
steps.explanation: Microsoft Entra RBAC grants administrative capabilities. Least privilege means selecting the narrowest role that satisfies the support task.

rules.description: The Password Administrator role page was opened

steps.title: Delegate password reset support at the right scope
steps.instruction: On the **Password Administrator** role page, use **Add assignments** to assign **Password Administrator** to **Contoso Helpdesk** at **Finance administrative unit** scope.
steps.hint: Do not choose Global Administrator, Privileged Role Administrator, User Administrator, or Tenant scope. Those choices exceed the scenario.
steps.explanation: Assigning the role to a role-assignable helpdesk group separates permissions from staffing, while the administrative-unit scope limits where those permissions work.

rules.description: Contoso Helpdesk has Password Administrator scoped to the Finance administrative unit
rules.failureFeedback: Assign Password Administrator to Contoso Helpdesk at Finance administrative unit scope.

steps.title: Verify least privilege
steps.instruction: Review the **Assignments** list and confirm **Contoso Helpdesk** has only **Password Administrator** at **Finance administrative unit** scope.
steps.hint: A correct result has one scoped helpdesk assignment and no Global Administrator, Privileged Role Administrator, User Administrator, or Tenant-scope helpdesk assignment.
steps.explanation: Verification catches privilege creep before it becomes a standing security risk. SC-900 expects you to recognize least-privilege role and scope choices.

labs.solution:
1. Select **All users** > **+ New user**.
2. In **New user**, enter **User principal name** `mira.ileri`, choose **contoso.example**, set **Mail nickname** `mira.ileri`, **Display name** `Mira Ileri`, keep **Auto-generate password (hidden in simulation)** and **Account enabled**.
3. On **Properties**, set **Job title** `Finance analyst`, **Department** `Finance`, and **Usage location** **Türkiye**. Select **Review + create** > **Create**.
4. Select **All groups** > **New group**. Choose **Security**, name it `Finance App Access`, keep **Microsoft Entra roles can be assigned to the group** off, and choose **Assigned** membership. Add **Mira Ileri** as **Members** and **Alex Wilber** as **Owners**, then **Create**.
5. Select **Administrative units**, open **Finance administrative unit**, and in **Update members** select **Adele Vance** and **Mira Ileri**, then **Save**.
6. Select **Roles & admins**, open **Password Administrator**, and in **Add assignments** choose **Contoso Helpdesk** at **Finance administrative unit** scope. Do not assign **Global Administrator**, **Privileged Role Administrator**, **User Administrator**, or **Tenant** scope.
